payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: A compact ResNet-style CNN with CIFAR-style 3x3 stride-1 stem (preserving 28x28 spatial resolution), progressive channel expansion (64→128→256), residual connections, and dataset-specific normalization will effectively capture both local nuclear morphology and tissue-level texture in 28x28 histopathology patches. With ~2.5M parameters it has sufficient capacity for 90k samples while fitting in limited GPU memory. The residual architecture enables deeper feature hierarchies without vanishing gradients, and the global average pooling + dropout head provides regularization against overfitting on small patches. Class-weighted CE (1.63:1 imbalance) and label smoothing (0.1) address the mild imbalance and label ambiguity risks.
